title: Guard has no CLI-native trigger — it fires only from the herdr plugin
description:
Arming is fixed (tk herd spawn registers the orchestrator pane), but the thing that INVOKES tk herd guard is still the herdr-ticks plugin hook on pane.agent_status_changed. Ticks ships as a CLI and a skill set; the plugin is optional, so on a machine without it the guard is armed and never runs.

Candidate CLI-native trigger: a harness stop-hook that runs `tk frontier --check` and refuses the turn end on exit 0. That is harness-specific (Claude Code Stop hooks, Codex equivalent) and belongs in the adapters, not in the plugin.

Decide whether the plugin hook stays the only mechanical trigger under herdr, and whether a harness stop-hook is the substrate-neutral answer.
acceptance_criteria: Either a CLI/skill-native trigger exists and is documented in the adapters, or the limitation is stated explicitly in herdr-runner.md as plugin-only.
